sources:
  - title: "MacPorts Download & Installation"
    url: "https://www.macports.org/install.php"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used: 
      - "Quickstart"
      - "Installing MacPorts" 
      - "macOS Package (.pkg) Installer"
      - "Source Installation"
      - "Git Sources"
      - "Selfupdate"
      
  - title: "Migration – MacPorts"
    url: "https://trac.macports.org/wiki/Migration"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used:
      - "Migration procedure"
      - "Run port migrate"
      - "Review macports.conf settings"
      
  - title: "FAQ – MacPorts"
    url: "https://trac.macports.org/wiki/FAQ"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used:
      - "General Questions"
      - "Will my MacPorts install continue to work"
      
  - title: "MacPorts Guide"
    url: "https://guide.macports.org"
    trust_level: "vendor"
    sections_used:
      - "Installing MacPorts"
      - "macOS Package Install"
      - "Source Install"
      - "MacPorts and the Shell"

ambiguities:
  - slot_name: "supported_os_versions"
    description: "Document mentions many macOS versions but doesn't clearly specify minimum requirements"
    options: 
      - "Support all listed versions (Leopard through Tahoe)"
      - "Only support currently maintained versions"
    suggested_default: "Support versions with available pkg installers (Ventura through Tahoe)"

tribal_knowledge:
  - title: "Migration Required for Major OS Updates"
    description: "MacPorts installations don't survive major OS upgrades. Must run migration procedure or reinstall completely when upgrading macOS major versions or changing CPU architecture."
    source_ref: "Migration wiki - main description"
    affects_phase: "install"
    
  - title: "Avoid /usr/local Conflicts"
    description: "Software in /usr/local can interfere with MacPorts builds. MacPorts uses /opt/local specifically to avoid conflicts with other package managers."
    source_ref: "FAQ - Can I install software in /usr/local"
    affects_phase: "install"
    
  - title: "Xcode Command Line Tools Required"
    description: "Even if full Xcode is installed, the command line tools must be separately installed using xcode-select --install. This is a common source of build failures."
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - Quickstart and Xcode sections"
    affects_phase: "prepare"
    
  - title: "Shell Configuration Modified by Installer"
    description: "The pkg installer automatically modifies shell configuration files (.zprofile, .profile, etc.) to set PATH and other environment variables. Manual source installs require manual shell setup."
    source_ref: "MacPorts Guide - MacPorts and the Shell"
    affects_phase: "provision"
    
  - title: "Regular Updates Essential"
    description: "Must run 'sudo port selfupdate' regularly to keep both MacPorts base and the ports tree current. This is critical for security and functionality."
    source_ref: "macports.org/install.php - multiple sections"
    affects_phase: "verify"
    
  - title: "Trace Mode for Build Issues" 
    description: "When ports fail to build due to conflicts with /usr/local or other external software, use trace mode 'sudo port -t install <portname>' to isolate the build environment."
    source_ref: "FAQ - Can I install software in /usr/local"
    affects_phase: "install"
